verdict.rationale: Runpod documents its own ways to move stored data off the platform: an S3-protocol compatible API for direct access to network volumes, CLI file transfer between your system and Runpod, and no data egress fees. That makes leaving with your files feasible over a standard protocol. However, nothing documents a comprehensive account-wide export of templates, endpoint configs, logs or billing history, and no export-format guarantees are stated. Missing for 10: documented full-account data export, explicit open-format export of non-file data (templates, endpoint configs, logs, billing), and independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
